actions.reason: K2_C0001 has an interpretable biological phenotype (oxidative-phosphorylation-high, immune/proliferative-up RNA program; VHL-depleted/BAP1-enriched mutation profile), but biological identity does not establish independent membership. Direct membership/boundary evidence is weak: set-level current-membership alignment in native geometries is only marginal (silhouettes 0.013-0.091, within-label distances barely below between-label), and the pair-scope report shows an essentially zero boundary silhouette (0.0003) with between-set affinity (0.00902) nearly equal to within-set affinity (0.00932), so the current boundary is not represented in fused geometry. The pair union is single-cluster dominated (candidate_k=1), so no internal subdivision rescue is warranted, and merge is not a legal action in this workflow. With independent retention unsupported and structural rescue unavailable, K2_C0001 is not retained.
